The '''Zaric sector''' lay in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Korev system/Legends|Korev system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The latter was the site of the astronomical object [[Korev VII]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Zaric Command]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operated within the Zaric [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' is set between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Linis]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] issued from Korev VII a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Cherioer]].<ref name="GG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zaric sector was introduced in the [[1994]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', which was written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Korev [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
